review_mode: Static source inspection only; no adapter or controls executed by reviewers; no source edits

findings.issue: Global ASCII hyphen deletion can hide a numeric minus sign in PDF-to-E4 comparison
findings.static_counterexample: compact("scored -7/14") equals compact("scored 7/14") under the reviewed implementation
findings.effect: A changed sign in one E4 block can be normalized away; other blocks still satisfy the inherited broad scored-k/14 assertion. Dates and ID punctuation are also erased.
findings.remedy: Preserve numeric signs and meaningful date/ID hyphens; limit normalization to whitespace, soft hyphens and explicitly validated alphabetic display-line breaks. Include a minus-sign negative control.

findings.issue: Font command rc0 plus a first line containing name does not require any valid font rows
findings.static_counterexample: Header-only pdffonts output has no Type3 rows and can satisfy both font_command_success and type3_zero
findings.effect: A malformed/truncated font report can be reported as strict font success
findings.remedy: Require a valid header/separator and at least one schema-valid font row; retain nonzero-return and malformed/header-only negative controls.

findings.issue: all() over fidelity files is vacuously true for an empty list; the complete unique required source set is not enforced
findings.effect: An empty/partial source-fidelity receipt can pass current-source hash binding; recorded per-file occurrences and only_E4_changed flags are not required by the adapter
findings.remedy: Require exactly the intended REPORT_DRAFT.md/main.tex/main-anonymous.tex set once each, each with three E4 replacements and only_E4_changed true; bind the approved-base SHA explicitly.

findings.issue: Actual PDF SHA is emitted but not compared with a verified build artifact SHA
findings.effect: Source-file hashes alone do not bind every PDF byte or all non-E4 PDF text to the reviewed source; the adapter relies on separate build/fidelity/visual receipts for this assurance
findings.remedy: Bind the tested PDF hash to the corresponding verified source-and-build receipt and preserve the separate full-source fidelity evidence.

correct_retained_behavior: Original authorized disclosure-scoped audit source is hash-pinned
Original sole QUEUE_IDS_IN_E4 FAIL is explicitly retained and never relabelled as PASS
Official native source validation runs through the pinned aggregate loader
Strict Anonymous Author(s) metadata is required by this anonymous adapter
Official IDs occur exactly three times and queue UUIDs must be absent

current_artifact_context.interpretation: These static counterexamples are not claims that the current PDFs contain negative scores, missing fonts, incomplete source records or wrong build bytes. Current named E4 values are visually positive7/14 and correctly rendered; source proof is separately recorded.
